facts.fact: The ACERWC, in concluding observations adopted at its session of 17-25 April 2026, records that Eritrea has developed a five-year Strategic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics Plan for 2024-2028; the document does not say whether the plan names a digital registration system.
facts.system: Civil registration and vital statistics system

note: No information system is named; the one fact is the CRVS plan, whose content the document does not describe. The capture is an excerpt ending in paragraph 8.
